title.en: Russian interference in the US presidential election

description.it: Intelligence e successivi rapporti del Senato USA documentano operazioni russe; non quantificano la variazione del voto né stabiliscono una cospirazione generale Trump-Russia.
description.en: Intelligence assessments and later US Senate reports document Russian operations; they do not quantify any change in the vote nor establish a general Trump-Russia conspiracy.
